title: Three Women Family Picnic, 1940 Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage sepia snapshot captured on July 4, 1940, as handwritten at the top margin (7-4-40). The photo shows three women identified on the back as Mother, Maudie, and Gertie enjoying an outdoor picnic on blankets spread across a grassy field. The clothing styles, including floral printed dresses and puffed sleeves, capture authentic 1940s fashion and American domestic life on the eve of World War II.
